annotations.text: F12 branded loader. The first two keep the wordmark's OWN 'o' (live text, wordmark font) and lock a spinning overlay to that glyph — no substituted circle. Each has Fit-to-glyph tweaks (radius / vertical centre) to seat the bead or arc exactly on the o, plus a Theme tweak across 5 palettes. All pure CSS, paint before hydration, and freeze on a held pose under prefers-reduced-motion. Wave is the fallback if the overlay can't be made to sit right. Pick one → it becomes Main and is committed to docs/design/mockups/.
